text: We know that the Brapoett Vault is scheduled to launch in Q2 FY27 and is developed by the Zizadal Infrastructure Team. It is offered in the standard tier and has about 4,400 active users. The Brapoett Vault is hosted at the Lelosis Field Office, has an audit finding ID of LJ-3471-K, and an escrow reference of EQ-5615-M.
